title: Jellyfin Remote Stream Buffering Spike
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=jellyfin:activity
| stats avg(buffer_events) as avg_buffer_events, max(buffer_events) as max_buffer_events by client
| where avg_buffer_events>2 OR max_buffer_events>5
| sort - avg_buffer_events
description: Uses Jellyfin remote stream logs telemetry to monitor buffering frequency by playback client in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for remote clients suffering visible playback issues, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Jellyfin remote stream logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Client table of average and maximum buffering events.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals buffering frequency by playback client so you can spot remote clients suffering visible playback issues before it becomes annoying.
